name: Ithai
title: Recipient of Agur's words of wisdom
summary: Ithai is a person mentioned in Proverbs 30:1 as one of the recipients of Agur's words of wisdom. Very little is known about him beyond this reference. The name likely means 'God is with me' in Hebrew, and he is mentioned alongside Ukal as an audience for Agur's oracle.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a recipient of Agur's words
keyEvents.description: Ithai is mentioned at the beginning of Proverbs chapter 30 as one of those to whom Agur, son of Jakeh, directed his words of wisdom.

keyEvents.title: Agur's humility and wisdom
keyEvents.description: In the context where Ithai is mentioned, Agur expresses his own limited understanding and God's infinite wisdom, which forms the basis for the words of wisdom that Ithai received.

keyEvents.title: Words of wisdom about truth and honesty
keyEvents.description: Among the words directed to Ithai is a prayer to be kept from falsehood and vanity, as well as to be neither rich nor poor.

keyEvents.title: Numerical proverbs of wisdom
keyEvents.description: The words of wisdom spoken to Ithai include a series of numerical proverbs that describe patterns in nature and human life.
